entries.scope: The author-distributed SingSeqCCver202303.nb worksheet was obtained and its 117 cached GraphicsBox outputs were parsed, checked for ordered labels 1..117, and redrawn as individual SVGs and a 20-page PDF catalog. This does not rerun Mathematica Algorithm I or independently prove classification completeness.

verify_no20_energy.py now replays the supplied shape polynomial and simple-root derivative, the original-row center/offset reduction to the displayed phase equation, all nine cube-root phase pairs, the finite signed-potential reduction, the power-mean lower bound x>=2^(2/3)>19/12, and the exact final Holder-gap polynomial. The asymptotic estimates producing the O(epsilon^3) root correction and second-order offsets remain analytic proof steps, not symbolic-computation outputs.

The manuscript proves the final two support cases analytically and the active generator replays the revised order certificate. The graph census and all other mass-factor evaluations are outside this entry.

The text exhausts all eight outer leading-coefficient patterns, all 15 seven-products, the intermediate interval and both endpoints. The two scripts replay the valuation order table, all eight leading-coefficient cases, endpoint force/tie reductions and exact positivity certificates; they do not regenerate the six-body graph classification.

The current text proves that no component of the full normalized incidence dominates four-mass space, for zero and nonzero drift. The script checks the rational spoke recovery, finite degree-eight signed cover and valuation contradiction; row-to-incidence extraction is derived in the text.

generate_no63_certificate.py replays eight leading K4 rows, nine finite-field CM sheet values and all 32 signed collinear branches. For the printed CM tuple, both variables use the fixed ordered root list (1,31555,473), and the manuscript now states this convention. Diagram-order hypotheses are inputs, not regenerated by this script.

Exact bridge ratios and K identity, the d>b to p<n sign step, both physical t floors, the bridge cubic-gap inequality, equal-weight 625D^2 bound, unequal-weight N1 bound, final Re(r)>1 sector, publication Sturm/Hurwitz data and rational constants replay. The extraction of leading cluster equations from the diagram is proved analytically in the text rather than regenerated from the classifier.

The current text covers collinear shapes, the nine-sheet non-collinear cover, vertical divisors, both orientations and zero-star strata; it no longer assumes global coverage or saturation. The listed exact/modular checks all replay. The dimension and properness arguments are proof steps in the text, not outputs of the scripts.

The local/equal/projective scripts check selected boundary charts. The remaining Puiseux valuation case split and properness argument are analytic proof steps in the current text, not an exhaustive symbolic code run.
